set.body:
Bounded first slice: execute and document one common raw-data-to-first-result journey through the existing public API; integrate with the current psychology-facing guide rather than add a parallel facade.

Use a licensed/fetch-reproducible small dataset with explicit geometry/time metadata. Record installation commands, expected outputs, diagnostics for a deliberately malformed input, and saved/reloaded equality. Compare the setup and task steps with the pinned pymovements equivalent. Compile/run the exact example outside the repository implementation classpath; identify unavailable quality/figure/export steps as blockers owned by PM1/PM4, not successful placeholders.

Acceptance: reproducible consumer receipt, a short task-first guide, honest unresolved gaps and a fixed usability-study task/rubric with primary outcome and thresholds. Link follow-up repairs as <=half-day slices. A scripted or agent-assisted completion is a developer smoke check, not researcher usability evidence; PM2 remains open until that separate evaluation passes.
set.title: PM2.1 Verify the first-analysis journey from a clean consumer installation
